title: LPSC 2026 1874: The FLIP Mission to Mons Mouton: Project Update
quote_mass: FLIP is a four-wheeled skid steer rover limited to the geometry and launch mass (480kg) initially designed for VIPER.
quote_hibernation: Astrolab is developing FLIP's operational concept for flexibility in landing times, communications availability, and lunar hibernation.
note: VIPER tie is launch-mass/geometry envelope only. Battery kWh, solar W, keepalive W, and thermal watts are not printed. Do not inherit VIPER 5420 Wh / 320 W arrays.
